hub.title: Climbing Board Apps | Boardsesh
hub.description: Find a climbing board app for Kilter, Tension, MoonBoard, Woods and more. Check compatible layouts, LED control and logbook imports before installing.
hub.heading: One climbing app for your boards
hub.intro: Get Boardsesh free for iPhone or Android to find climbs, light compatible boards, and keep one logbook across the walls you climb. With a shared session, your crew can add problems to the same queue from their own phones.
hub.compatibility: Choose your board below to check the exact layout, how to connect to the LEDs, and whether you can bring your logbook. If you set on your own holds, start with the spray wall comparison.
hub.tradeoffs: You can explore the browser app before your session. Browser LED control requires Web Bluetooth and a compatible controller. On iPhone, use the native app for Bluetooth lighting.
hub.screenshotAlt: Boardsesh shared climb queue with problems and grades from a group session

related.bluetooth: Connect to a board over Bluetooth

kilter.title: Kilter Board App Guide | Boardsesh
kilter.description: Use Boardsesh on Kilter Board Original or Homewall. Light climbs, share a queue, and import your current Kilter logbook or older Aurora export.
kilter.heading: Boardsesh for Kilter Board
kilter.intro: Boardsesh is an independent alternative to the official Kilter Board app. Download it for iPhone or Android to find problems, light the board, share a queue with your crew and keep one logbook across boards.
kilter.compatibility: Boardsesh supports Kilter Board Original and Homewall. Match the wall size, installed hold sets and angle before you pick a climb. LED control requires a compatible Bluetooth controller.
kilter.tradeoffs: Use Boardsesh if you want a shared queue and a logbook across board brands. Use Kilter’s app to manage your Kilter profile, recover old setter credit or keep new activity in your Kilter account. Imports into Boardsesh run one way.
kilter.screenshotAlt: Boardsesh displaying a Kilter climb with the starting, middle and finishing holds marked

layout.title: Match the wall
layout.body: Pick Original or Homewall, then match the size, hold sets and angle at your gym or home wall. Filter by grade or try Kilter’s Verified climbs.

queue.title: Light a climb and share the queue
queue.body: Connect from the app while you’re near the LEDs. Start a shared session so each climber can add their next problem from their own phone.

import.title: Bring your Kilter history
import.body: Open Settings → Connected apps. Link the current Kilter account to bring in sends, attempts, ratings and circuits. Boardsesh encrypts the account token it stores. For social-only sign-in or two-factor authentication, use Import on the Kilter (new) card. For the old Aurora app, upload its JSON export on the Kilter (Aurora) card.

discovery.label: Find climbs
discovery.boardsesh: Browse Original and Homewall, filter by grade and find Kilter’s Verified climbs.
discovery.official: Browse Kilter problems by grade and other filters, with Verified climbs selected by Kilter.

session.label: Climb with others
session.boardsesh: Connect to the LEDs and build a live queue together from separate phones.
session.official: Bluetooth lighting, a board map and shareable climbs.

history.label: Keep your history
history.boardsesh: Current Kilter account import or old Aurora JSON. New entries stay in Boardsesh.
history.official: Log attempts and sends in Kilter. The Claim Data process accepts an old Aurora export.

tension.title: Tension Board App Guide for TB1 and TB2 | Boardsesh
tension.description: Climb on Tension Board 1 or TB2 Mirror and Spray with Boardsesh. Find problems, run a workout and import your Tension logbook.
tension.heading: Boardsesh for Tension Board
tension.intro: Boardsesh is an independent alternative to the official Tension Board app for TB1 and TB2. Use it on iPhone or Android to find climbs at your wall angle, light them and keep your sends from every board in one logbook.
tension.compatibility: Boardsesh supports Tension Board 1 and Tension Board 2 in both Mirror and Spray layouts. TB2 Spray is the manufactured Tension hold layout. For a wall with your own hold placement, use the photo-based spray wall setup.
tension.tradeoffs: The official Tension app has circuits and a timer. Stay with it if your training and history already live there. Boardsesh supports group queues and cross-board logging, and can copy your Tension history in one direction.
tension.screenshotAlt: Boardsesh displaying a Tension Board climb and its marked holds

layout.title: Choose TB1, TB2 Mirror or TB2 Spray
layout.body: Match your wall’s hold layout, dimensions and angle. Check the layout first if the LEDs seem to mark a different problem from the diagram.

training.title: Build a session at that angle
training.body: Filter the climb list by grade and angle. Save warm-ups to a playlist or pick 4x4s for a session with four climbs repeated over four rounds.

import.title: Bring in older sessions
import.body: Link the Tension account in Settings → Connected apps, or upload your Aurora JSON export. Any new ticks you log in Boardsesh stay here.

layout.label: Walls
layout.boardsesh: TB1 plus TB2 Mirror and Spray, with other board brands in the same app.
layout.official: Aurora lists the Tension app alongside Tension Board 1 and 2. Tension documents Mirror and Spray for TB2.

training.label: Plan a session
training.boardsesh: Use playlists, a shared queue and workouts such as 4x4s.
training.official: Tension documents creating circuits and using a timer in the app.

history.label: Log sends
history.boardsesh: Bring in Tension history and log across your supported boards.
history.official: Log ascents and see your history in the Tension app.

moonboard.title: MoonBoard App Guide | Boardsesh
moonboard.description: Browse MoonBoard Benchmarks and Mini MoonBoard climbs in Boardsesh. Check your hold setup, supported legacy LED controllers and CSV import.
moonboard.heading: Boardsesh for MoonBoard
moonboard.intro: Boardsesh is an independent alternative to the official MoonBoard app. Download it for iPhone or Android to find Benchmarks, share a warm-up queue and keep MoonBoard attempts and sends in the same logbook as your other boards.
moonboard.compatibility: Browse the 2010, 2016, Masters 2017, Masters 2019 and 2024 setups, plus Mini MoonBoard 2020 and 2025. LED support is a separate check. Boardsesh has code support for the legacy Nordic UART and RedBear profiles. The third legacy profile and the Pro controller are unsupported.
moonboard.tradeoffs: Choose Boardsesh to browse and log across boards or to light holds with a supported legacy controller. For Moon’s Pro controller or official problem publishing, use Moon’s app. The controller list comes from a code audit, and support can vary by the hardware on your wall.
moonboard.screenshotAlt: Boardsesh displaying a MoonBoard climb on its numbered hold grid

setup.title: Pick the installed hold setup
setup.body: Match the setup year and wall angle before filtering for Benchmarks. The Mini setups have their own climb lists and grid.

controller.title: Check the LED controller
controller.body: If your board uses a supported legacy profile, connect in the app and try one climb. You can still follow the on-screen grid and log the session with the LEDs off.

import.title: Copy your MoonBoard logbook
import.body: If you have a MoonBoard CSV export, open the MoonBoard card in Settings → Connected apps and import the file. It copies matching logbook entries into Boardsesh.

benchmarks.label: Find problems
benchmarks.boardsesh: Browse by setup and angle and filter for Benchmarks.
benchmarks.official: Browse problems for your hold setup, including Benchmarks curated by MoonBoard moderators.

lighting.label: LED control
lighting.boardsesh: Legacy Nordic UART and RedBear profiles. Check your controller before relying on LEDs.
lighting.official: Moon supports its LED system in the official app and publishes hardware and setup instructions.

history.label: Log a session
history.boardsesh: Copy a CSV into a logbook shared across supported boards. Future ticks stay in Boardsesh.
history.official: Log sessions and save problem lists to your MoonBoard account.

decoy.title: Decoy Board App Guide | Boardsesh
decoy.description: Use Boardsesh on the Decoy Dungeon Trainer. Choose your wall size, light climbs, share turns with your crew and bring over your Aurora logbook.
decoy.heading: Boardsesh for Decoy Board
decoy.intro: Use Boardsesh as an independent alternative to the official Decoy Board app on your Dungeon Trainer. Download it for iPhone or Android to share a queue, light problems and keep your Decoy ticks alongside your other board sends.
decoy.compatibility: Choose Dungeon Trainer and match the 8 × 10, 8 × 12 or 12 × 12 wall. Pick the actual size before browsing so you see problems that fit the installed holds.
decoy.tradeoffs: Boardsesh is a fit when your crew takes turns or your training spans multiple boards. The official Decoy app documents a side-climb filter for the edges of the 12 × 12 and has its own Selects and leaderboards.
decoy.screenshotAlt: Decoy Board Dungeon Trainer layout with rows of coloured holds and dense footholds

size.title: Find climbs that fit your Dungeon Trainer
size.body: Set the size and angle before filtering. A problem on the wider 12 × 12 can use holds beyond the edges of an 8-foot wall.

turns.title: Give everyone a turn
turns.body: Connect to the LED kit, start a shared session and have your crew add problems to the queue while the current climber is on the wall.

history.title: Bring over Decoy ticks
history.body: Use the Decoy card in Settings → Connected apps to link your Aurora account or upload a JSON export. The import copies your history into Boardsesh.

search.label: Find problems
search.boardsesh: Browse for the Dungeon Trainer size and angle you climb.
search.official: Browse Decoy climbs, including Selects and a documented filter for climbs near the sides.

session.label: At the wall
session.boardsesh: Light climbs from a shared queue and log with your other boards.
session.official: Control the Decoy LED kit, log ascents and attempts, and find beta videos.

touchstone.title: Touchstone Board App Guide | Boardsesh
touchstone.description: Climb on the Touchstone Winter 2020 board with Boardsesh. Find problems, light compatible LEDs and bring over your Aurora history.
touchstone.heading: Boardsesh for Touchstone Board
touchstone.intro: For the Winter 2020 layout, Boardsesh is an independent alternative to the official Touchstone Board app. Download it for iPhone or Android to browse problems for that wall and log attempts alongside the rest of your board climbing.
touchstone.compatibility: Select Touchstone, Winter 2020 and Full Size for that installed layout. This guide covers the LED training board. For gym membership, check-in or classes, use Touchstone Climbing’s gym services.
touchstone.tradeoffs: Boardsesh keeps your Touchstone projects and your other board sessions together. Aurora’s Touchstone Board app serves the board’s own climbing community, including its beta videos and climber profiles.

grasshopper.title: Grasshopper Board App Guide | Boardsesh
grasshopper.description: Use Boardsesh on Grasshopper 2020 Ninja, Master and GrandMaster walls. Match your size, light problems and import your Aurora logbook.
grasshopper.heading: Boardsesh for Grasshopper Board
grasshopper.intro: On Grasshopper 2020 walls, Boardsesh is an independent alternative to the official Grasshopper Board app. Download it for iPhone or Android to find climbs at your angle, connect to the wall and log sessions alongside your other boards.
grasshopper.compatibility: Choose Grasshopper 2020 and match Ninja (8 × 10), Master (8 × 12) or GrandMaster (12 × 12). Check the holds installed on the wall, including the Tweener options shown for your board.
grasshopper.tradeoffs: Boardsesh gives a crew one queue and gives each climber a logbook across boards. The official Grasshopper app documents its own climb creation, beta sharing and LED integration.

woods.title: Woods Board App Guide | Boardsesh
woods.description: Browse Woods Board climbs in Boardsesh with matching and feet rules. Check your 8 × 10 or 12 × 12 layout before lighting a problem.
woods.heading: Boardsesh for Woods Board
woods.intro: Boardsesh is an independent alternative to the official Woods Board app. Download it for iPhone or Android, select your wall size and check the matching and feet rules. Light compatible LEDs or follow the hold diagram.
woods.compatibility: Boardsesh supports the 8 × 10 and 12 × 12 Woods Board. Each size uses its own hold and LED map. The climb shows whether matching is allowed and whether you can use any feet.
woods.tradeoffs: Pick Boardsesh to log new Woods climbs alongside your other boards. For your existing Woods account, official database publishing and the Woods leaderboards, use the Woods Board app. Boardsesh has no Woods account import.
woods.screenshotAlt: Woods Board Original 12 × 12 layout with wooden handholds and footholds

size.title: Choose 8 × 10 or 12 × 12
size.body: Use the size installed on your wall, even if the other version looks familiar. The hold grid for the problem needs to match the actual wall.

rules.title: Check matching and feet before you pull on
rules.body: Open the climb details and read both rules. A climb can allow matching and still tell you to use designated feet.

session.title: Log today’s climbing
session.body: Light the climb on a compatible Woods LED controller or follow the diagram on screen. Log the send or attempt from the climb.

rules.label: Set and climb by the rules
rules.boardsesh: See and set matching and feet rules on the selected size’s hold map.
rules.official: The Woods app lets setters specify rules for problems they publish.

spray-wall-apps.title: Spray Wall Apps Compared: Stōkt and Retro Flash | Boardsesh
spray-wall-apps.description: Compare Boardsesh, Stōkt and Retro Flash for a home or gym spray wall. See photo setup, sharing, circuits, optional LED control and pricing.
spray-wall-apps.heading: Compare spray wall climbing apps
spray-wall-apps.intro: With Boardsesh, take a photo of your spray wall, set problems on it, and keep those sessions in the same logbook as your catalogue boards. Stōkt and Retro Flash also offer tools for home walls and gyms. The right fit depends on how you set, share and reset your wall.
spray-wall-apps.compatibility: Boardsesh can detect holds in a wall photo and lets you correct the results before publishing. Climb using the on-screen holds, or map the wall to compatible WLED hardware for lighting. Download Boardsesh on iPhone or Android to set up the wall.
spray-wall-apps.tradeoffs: Choose Boardsesh if you want photo setting and the same group queue and logbook across walls. Look at Stōkt if your gym needs managed setup, official gym lists or organized competitions. Retro Flash is worth a look for custom grading systems, partly symmetrical walls and competition boulders.
spray-wall-apps.screenshotAlt: Boardsesh spray wall photo with selected holds marked for a boulder problem

photo.title: Start with a front-on photo
photo.body: Let Boardsesh find the holds, then add any it missed or fix outlines before you start setting. If you have compatible WLED lights, map the holds to the LEDs.

sharing.title: Set for yourself or share with a crew
sharing.body: Choose Private, Link only or Public. Private walls attached to a gym are also visible to members of that gym. Set a few problems and save them to a playlist for a circuit.

reset.title: Reset an existing spray wall
reset.body: Tap your existing wall’s name on the Climbs tab, then choose Reset this Spraywall. Add a new photo and review the holds. When you publish the reset, Boardsesh archives the previous wall with its climbs so your old sends keep their original problems.

setup.label: Set up a wall
setup.boardsesh: Photo-based hold detection and a hold editor. Choose Private, Link only or Public.
setup.stokt: Automatic hold mapping from a photo, a desktop editor and an optional managed setup.
setup.retroFlash: Supports private, adjustable, symmetrical and partly symmetrical walls.

features.label: Set and share
features.boardsesh: Set problems, save circuits as playlists and share a live queue.
features.stokt: Pro documents official gym lists, custom competitions and adjustable angles.
features.retroFlash: Set circuits and competition boulders, with built-in and custom grading systems.

lighting.label: LED lighting
lighting.boardsesh: Optional mapped WLED over Wi-Fi. Bluetooth requires compatible hardware with Boardsesh support.
lighting.stokt: Stōkt Pro documents LED walls, including an option to connect your own LEDs.
lighting.retroFlash: LED compatibility wasn’t specified in the developer’s store listings.

price.label: Pricing
price.boardsesh: Free app download. Lighting hardware is separate.
price.stokt: Free home starting plan, paid gym and home options. The Pro page lists $20 per month.
price.retroFlash: Free download and in-app purchases. The US App Store lists a $4.99 Home Wall Year Pass.
